items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Arrangements, and I played piano for her.

ctx.x: Arrangements, and I played piano for her. I followed a guy that's an excellent pianist. He was with her for quite some time -- Bobby Tucker who now is Billy Eckstine's Eckstein's pianist. He's been with him for quite a few years. Well, he was with Billie Holiday previous to that, so he left

Billie Holiday, and went with Billy Eckstine, so I took his place, and she came down to hear my group where we were playing, and we were playing a theatre, and what knocked Billie out, I think, where I'm concerned -- where I was concerned, rather, is the fact that she had some music, and it was for a big band, and it hadn't been condensed where six pieces could play, so what I would do, I would look at all the parts, and where there would be seven bars out, with this particular horn, what's important, you know, I…
